title: Week 1
subtitle: Power Rankings

memo.yearText: Bijan Robinson most rushing yards in the NFL. After week 1 he's 10th with 83. Not great, Nick.
memo.weekText: Dean is picking this week's Dean of the Week. This bar gets updated when he sends it. Also: Shama gets $50 for high score of the week (180).

intro: One week in. Big Sham dropped 180 and collects $50. Dean started two quarterbacks and got negative points. Nick lost by 75, changed his team name, and Bijan is 10th in rushing.
Records and points are real now. Rank is still Tony's opinion. Argue in the chat.

quickHits.text: Big Sham, 180 points, high score of the week, fifty bucks. Josh Allen 42.3, Derrick Henry 35.3, and D'Andre Swift scored 32.4 on his BENCH. He left 27 points sitting there and still won by 61.

quickHits.label: Negative QBs
quickHits.text: Deanus started Kyler Murray (-3.1) and Sam Darnold (0.0). Kyler got knocked out on his 11th snap as a Viking. Darnold didn't play. Two quarterback slots, minus three points, in a league that pays 6 per passing TD. AJ Brown is on IR and Josh Jacobs is on the exempt list. The Tweakers are 0-1 and it's worse than it sounds.

quickHits.label: The Watson curse
quickHits.text: J Will benched Christian Watson. Watson scored 32.7. J Will started Jaylen Waddle at WR for 1.2 and Brock Bowers for 0.0 (inactive, knee). Lost to Tony by 7.2. He would have won with Watson in. The guy Nick drafted by accident is now haunting a different team.

quickHits.label: Shough
quickHits.text: Tyler Shough led the entire NFL in passing yards in week 1 with 410. He is on Nokia Wolson's bench. Nicky started Kyle Pitts at FLEX instead for 0.0 and lost to Reece by 7.6. Shough scored 26.8. Do the math. Or don't, Nicky didn't.

quickHits.label: Lost by 61
quickHits.text: Seeberger scored 119 with the highest projected lineup in the league. Stafford threw for 245 yards and a touchdown and somehow scored 2.9. Jalen Coker had 33.8 on his bench. Named after Waddle, still doesn't own him, and Waddle scored 1.2 anyway so it's fine.

quickHits.label: Fair Weather
quickHits.text: Nfatboy scored 92 points, lost by 75 to the champ, and renamed the team to Fair Weather Fallows. After one game. Bo Nix 4.2, Baker 7.0, Aubrey 2.0. Bijan had 31 of the 92.

quickHits.label: Won ugly
quickHits.text: EN started Ja'Marr Chase (3.2), Colston Loveland (0.0) and Drake Maye (6.7) and won by 19 because he was playing Dean. 101 points. 1-0. The Ball Sniffers way.

quickHits.label: Waiver wire
quickHits.text: Total waiver moves in the league after week 1: one. REEEEECE picked up Kaleb Johnson. That's it. Tony hasn't even made one yet, which is a personal record.

rankings.thoughts: Deanus. Started two quarterbacks and got -3.1 points out of the position. Kyler took a helmet to the head on his 11th snap as a Viking and Darnold was in street clothes. AJ Brown went on IR before the game. Josh Jacobs pled no contest and is on the exempt list. Goedert was his best player. The 82 points is the lowest score in the league and it wasn't close to his own optimal lineup either. Dont truzz u.

Nfatboy. 92 points. Bijan had 31 of them. The two quarterbacks he was so proud of, Nix and Baker, combined for 11.2. Aubrey missed everything. Lost by 75 to the champ and immediately changed the team name to Fair Weather Fallows, which is at least self aware. Also his Dean of the Year pick, Bijan most rushing yards, is currently 10th, behind Kyle Monangai. One game, Nick. One.

EN. 1-0. Also scored 101 points, second lowest in the league, and only won because the schedule handed him Dean. Ja'Marr Chase 3.2. Colston Loveland 0.0. Drake Maye 6.7. Hurts and David Montgomery carried a team that would have lost to everyone else. Chuba Hubbard had 23.7 on the bench. Ball Sniffers doing Ball Sniffers things: win, learn nothing.

J Will. Lost to Tony by 7.2 with Christian Watson (32.7) on the bench. The Watson that Nick drafted by accident, that J Will then drafted on purpose, that J Will then benched. Started Waddle for 1.2 and Bowers for 0.0 because Bowers was inactive and nobody checked. Dart went for 34.4 in the OP slot which is the only reason it was close. Magic 8 Ball says: check the injury report.

Seeberger. Highest projected lineup in the league, scored 119, lost by 61. Stafford threw for 245 and a touchdown and it came out to 2.9 fantasy points, which shouldn't be possible. Jalen Coker had 33.8 on the bench. ARSB and Olave did their jobs. The team is still named after a guy he doesn't own, and that guy scored 1.2, so honestly he dodged one.

Tony. Won by 7 over J Will because J Will benched Watson. Gibbs 31.6, Zay 26. Drake London 5.5. Left Monangai (20.4), Parker Washington (19.3) and Deebo (18) on the bench, so the optimal lineup was 176. Gibbs is 2nd in the NFL in rushing, 73 yards ahead of Bijan, which matters for Dean of the Year reasons. Zero waiver moves so far. He's fine. Concerningly fine.

meme.top: TONY WATCHING MONANGAI SCORE 20 ON HIS BENCH
meme.caption: still won tho

rankings.thoughts: Nokia Wolson. Caleb Williams 43.5, the best player in the league this week, and Trevor Lawrence 36.3. Two quarterbacks for 80 points and he STILL lost, because he started Kyle Pitts at FLEX for zero and left Tyler Shough, who led the whole NFL in passing yards, on the bench with 26.8. 153 points in a loss. Preseason #1 to 0-1 in one Sunday. Puka had 12.4 and nobody got bit, so progress.

REEEEECE. Beat the preseason #1. Kenneth Walker 34.1 and 173 rushing yards, most in the NFL, 90 more than Bijan. JJ 31.2, Lamar and Purdy both cleared 26. Malik Willis scored 16.9 on the bench as a QB3, which is more than half the league's QB2s. Made the ONLY waiver move in the league so far (Kaleb Johnson). Charbonnet still on IR. Still questionable everywhere. Still soppin, no wait that's Daniel.

meme.top: CAN'T MAKE A BAD WAIVER MOVE
meme.bottom: IF YOU'RE THE ONLY ONE WHO MADE ONE
meme.caption: 1 move, league-wide

rankings.thoughts: Big Sham. 180 points. High score of the week. Fifty dollars. Josh Allen 42.3, Derrick Henry 35.3, Javonte 24.2, Jordan Love 23 in the OP. D'Andre Swift scored 32.4 and was on the bench, so the optimal lineup was 207. Last year's lowest scoring team just dropped 180 in week 1 with 27 points left over. Davante had 5.6 and Ferguson 2.6 so the WR/TE thing is still real, but the engine is enormous.

D. REIGNING CHAMP, 1-0, 167.5, second highest score of the week, and Isaiah Likely put up 27.8 on his bench. Jeanty 32.7, JSN 26.2, Mahomes and Goff both over 22. Beat Nick by 75. This is what it looks like when the guy who makes 31 waiver moves also drafts well. Still soppin.

outro: Week 2 rankings drop Tuesday. Dean, send the Dean of the Week.
